name: Egyptian Hieroglyphs
notes: `latest: null` reflects that hieroglyphic use is conventionally described as ending in Late Antiquity (the last securely dated hieroglyphic inscription is often cited as the Philae temple graffito of 394 CE); that endpoint was not independently re-verified this session and should not be read as "still in active use" — flagged for follow-up. Whether Egyptian hieroglyphs are independent of or influenced by contact with proto-cuneiform Mesopotamia (stimulus diffusion of the general idea of writing, not sign-borrowing) is a live, unresolved question — see claim_egyptian_origin_type.
